title: 第七章 镜中少女的倒影第八章 烈焰与藤蔓的较量
lines: 第七章：镜中少女的倒影
傍晚的霞光透过幻境学院的彩绘玻璃窗，在走廊地面投下斑驳的光斑。月姬抱着刚领到的《幻术基础图谱》，脚步放得很轻，仿佛怕惊扰了空气中浮动的魔法粒子。她的宿舍在走廊尽头，是间单人房——这是学院给镜幻国学子的特殊安排，据说为了“避免镜像能力干扰他人”，但在月姬看来，更像是一种无声的隔离。
钥匙插进锁孔时，她习惯性地瞥了眼门旁镶嵌的穿衣镜。镜面光洁，映出她纤瘦的身影：灰蓝色的长发垂到腰际，额间一点淡银色的印记，那是镜幻国皇室旁支的象征，也是她不愿示人的标记。
推门而入，宿舍里静得能听见自己的呼吸。月姬将书放在桌上，转身准备去倒杯水，眼角的余光却突然瞥见桌上的铜镜——那是她从家乡带来的旧物，边缘刻着繁复的镜像符文，此刻镜中映出的，竟不是她的背影。
月姬的心跳猛地漏了一拍。
她缓缓转过身，视线牢牢锁在铜镜上。镜中确实有个身影，穿着学院的统一制服，灰蓝色的长发，额间的银印……和她长得一模一样。但那身影的姿势不对，她此刻是站着的，镜中人却像是坐着，双手交叠放在膝上，甚至微微侧着头，仿佛在透过镜面打量她。
更诡异的是，当她抬起左手时，镜中人动的却是右手。
这不是普通的镜像。月姬的指尖泛起一层薄汗，她在镜幻国时就听说过“镜像显真”的传说——当镜子足够古老，且与观者血脉相连时，或许能照出“另一个存在”，可能是过去的残影，也可能是……未可知的未来。
她深吸一口气，试探着往前走了两步。镜中人也随之靠近，距离拉近后，月姬看清了对方的眼睛——那不是她自己那双总是带着怯懦的灰蓝色眼眸，镜中人的眼底藏着一丝她从未有过的锐利，甚至还带着淡淡的疲惫，像是经历过漫长的跋涉。
“你是谁？”月姬的声音有些发颤，在空荡的宿舍里格外清晰。
镜中人没有回答，只是微微张口，嘴唇动了动，却没有声音传出来。月姬凑近了些，几乎要贴上镜面，鼻尖能感受到铜镜冰凉的温度。她看见镜中人的嘴唇重复着两个字，很慢，很轻，像是怕被什么人听见。
月姬凝神辨认着口型——
“什么？”月姬追问，心跳如擂鼓。星图？是古籍库失窃的那张吗？她昨天在预备班的课堂上，才听导师提过星图与秘境的关联。
镜中人似乎没听见她的话，只是抬手，指尖轻轻点在镜面上。顺着那指尖的方向，月姬看见镜中宿舍的背景开始变化，墙壁变得模糊，浮现出流动的光影，像是水波荡漾。光影中渐渐显露出一个场景：高耸的书架，积灰的古籍，还有一个半开的木盒，盒中似乎放着一卷泛黄的羊皮纸——那场景，像极了导师描述过的古籍库。
突然，镜中的光影剧烈地晃动起来，像是被什么东西打碎了。镜中人的表情变得紧张，猛地抬头看向镜外的月姬，眼神急切，又抬手指了指自己额间的银印，然后指向镜面深处，最后做了一个“快跑”的手势。
“等等！”月姬伸手想触碰镜面，就在她的指尖即将碰到镜中人的刹那，铜镜突然发出一阵刺耳的嗡鸣，镜面泛起白光，所有影像瞬间消失无踪。
镜子恢复了正常，只映出她惊慌失措的脸，额间的银印在灯光下泛着微弱的光泽。
月姬踉跄着后退一步，撞到了身后的书桌，《幻术基础图谱》掉在地上，发出“啪”的轻响。她蹲下身去捡书，手指触到书页时，才发现自己的手在不停地发抖。
刚才的一切是幻觉吗？可那镜中人的眼神，那清晰的口型，还有古籍库的影像……都真实得不像假的。她额间的银印，镜中人为什么要指它？难道自己的血脉，和星图、和秘境有关？
月姬抱紧膝盖，将脸埋在臂弯里。她想起三年前离开镜幻国时，祖母把这面铜镜塞进她手里，只说“关键时刻，它会告诉你该做什么”，当时她只当是老人的胡话，现在想来，祖母或许早就知道些什么。
窗外的天色彻底暗了下来，走廊里传来其他学生的说笑声，衬得这间宿舍愈发安静。月姬慢慢抬起头，再次看向桌上的铜镜。镜面平静无波，映着窗外的月光，像一片凝固的湖水。
她犹豫了片刻，伸手拿起铜镜，指尖拂过边缘的符文。冰凉的金属触感让她稍微镇定了些。她走到穿衣镜前，将铜镜举到面前，让两面镜子形成交错的角度——这是镜幻国孩童都知道的小游戏，能在交错的镜面中看到无数个自己。
但这一次，交错的镜面里没有出现无数个月姬。
在两面镜子的夹角深处，光影扭曲的地方，隐约有个模糊的轮廓，比她高大，穿着深色的斗篷，看不清脸，只能看到一只手握着什么东西，那东西反射出细碎的光芒，像是……金属的边角？
月姬屏住呼吸，想看得更清楚些，那轮廓却突然消散了，只留下一片混沌的光影。
就在这时，宿舍门被敲响了。
“月姬同学？你在里面吗？”是林澈的声音，带着少年人特有的清朗，“导师让我们去趟训练场，说是有临时加训。”
月姬连忙将铜镜收好，塞进枕头底下，定了定神才走过去开门。
门外站着林澈，还有苏璃和凯。林澈手里拿着一本魔法理论书，苏璃抱着一盆小小的绿植，凯则背着他的火焰法杖，三人脸上都带着些许疑惑。
“你脸色不太好，”苏璃关切地问，指尖轻轻碰了碰她的手臂，“是不是不舒服？”
月姬摇摇头，避开了苏璃的目光：“没事，可能有点累。我们走吧。”
她跟着三人往训练场走，走廊的灯光在地面投下他们交错的影子。月姬忍不住回头看了眼自己的宿舍门，心里反复回响着镜中人的口型和那个模糊的轮廓。
星图……银印……深色斗篷……
这些碎片像散落的拼图，她还不知道它们能拼出什么，但一种强烈的预感在心底升起——这场关于秘境的探寻，或许从很早以前，就已经和她的命运缠绕在一起了。
训练场的风带着草木的气息吹过来，月姬拢了拢额前的碎发，将那丝不安压了下去。不管镜中藏着什么秘密，她知道，自己不能再像以前那样躲在镜子后面了。

Chapter Seven: The Girl’s Reflection in the Mirror
The evening light shines through the stained glass windows of Illusion Academy, casting mottled light spots on the corridor floor. Yue Ji held the "Basic Atlas of Illusion" she had just received and walked very lightly, as if she was afraid of disturbing the magic particles floating in the air. Her dormitory is at the end of the corridor and is a single room - this is a special arrangement given by the college to students from the Mirror Fantasy Kingdom. It is said that it is to "avoid the mirror ability from disturbing others", but in Tsukiji's view, it is more like a silent isolation.
When the key was inserted into the keyhole, she habitually glanced at the mirror embedded next to the door. The mirror was smooth and clean, reflecting her slender figure: long gray-blue hair hanging down to her waist, and a light silver mark on her forehead, which was a symbol of the branch of the royal family of Jinghuan Kingdom, and also a mark that she did not want to show to others.
Pushing the door open, the dormitory was so quiet that you could hear your own breathing. Yue Ji put the book on the table and turned around to pour a glass of water. Out of the corner of her eye, she suddenly caught a glimpse of the bronze mirror on the table - it was an old thing she brought from her hometown, with complicated mirror runes engraved on the edge. What was reflected in the mirror at this moment was not her back.
Yue Ji's heartbeat suddenly skipped a beat.
She turned around slowly, her eyes firmly locked on the bronze mirror. There is indeed a figure in the mirror, wearing the uniform of the college, with long gray-blue hair, and a silver mark on his forehead... he looks exactly like her. But the figure's posture was wrong. She was standing at the moment, but the person in the mirror seemed to be sitting, with his hands folded on his knees, and even his head tilted slightly, as if he was looking at her through the mirror.
What's even weirder is that when she raised her left hand, the person in the mirror moved her right hand.
This is no ordinary mirror. A thin layer of sweat formed on Yue Ji's fingertips. She had heard the legend of "mirror reflection" when she was in the Mirror Fantasy Kingdom - when the mirror is old enough and connected to the viewer's blood, it may be able to reflect "another existence", which may be an afterimage of the past, or it may be... the unknown future.
She took a deep breath and took two tentative steps forward. The person in the mirror also came closer. After the distance was shortened, Yue Ji saw the other person's eyes clearly - they were not her own pair of timid gray-blue eyes. There was a sharpness in the eyes of the person in the mirror that she had never seen before, and even a touch of fatigue, as if she had experienced a long journey.
"Who are you?" Yue Ji's voice was trembling, which was particularly clear in the empty dormitory.
The person in the mirror did not answer, but opened his mouth slightly and moved his lips, but no sound came out. Yue Ji came closer, almost touching the mirror, and the tip of her nose could feel the cold temperature of the bronze mirror. She saw the man in the mirror repeating two words on his lips, very slowly and softly, as if he was afraid of being heard by someone.
Yue Ji concentrated on identifying the mouth shape——
"Star map..."
"What?" Yue Ji asked, her heart beating like a drum. Star map? Is it the one stolen from the ancient book library? She was in the preparatory class yesterday and heard the instructor mention the connection between the star map and the secret realm.
The person in the mirror didn't seem to hear her words. He just raised his hand and lightly tapped the mirror with his fingertips. Following the direction of the fingertip, Yue Ji saw that the background of the dormitory in the mirror began to change, the walls became blurred, and flowing light and shadow emerged, like rippling water. A scene gradually emerged in the light and shadow: towering bookshelves, dusty ancient books, and a half-open wooden box, which seemed to contain a roll of yellowed parchment - the scene was very much like the ancient book library described by the instructor.
Suddenly, the light and shadow in the mirror shook violently, as if it had been shattered by something. The expression of the person in the mirror became tense, and he suddenly looked up at Yue Ji outside the mirror with eager eyes. He raised his finger and pointed at the silver mark on his forehead, then pointed to the depth of the mirror, and finally made a "run quickly" gesture.
"Wait!" Yue Ji reached out to touch the mirror. Just when her fingertips were about to touch the person in the mirror, the bronze mirror suddenly emitted a harsh buzz, the mirror surface glowed with white light, and all images disappeared instantly.
The mirror returned to normal, only reflecting her panicked face, and the silver mark on her forehead glowed faintly under the light.
Yue Ji staggered back and bumped into the desk behind her. The "Basic Atlas of Illusion" fell to the ground with a soft "snap". She knelt down to pick up the book. When her fingers touched the pages, she realized that her hands were shaking.
Was everything just an illusion? But the eyes of the person in the mirror, the clear mouth shape, and the image in the ancient book library... are all too real to be fake. Why did the person in the mirror point to the silver mark on her forehead? Could it be that my bloodline is related to the star map and the secret realm?
Yue Ji hugged her knees tightly and buried her face in her arms. She recalled that when she left Mirror Fantasy Country three years ago, her grandmother had thrust this bronze mirror into her hand and only said, "At critical moments, it will tell you what to do." At that time, she thought it was just the old man's nonsense. Now that she thought about it, her grandmother might have known something.
The sky outside the window had completely darkened, and other students' chatter and laughter could be heard in the corridor, making the dormitory even quieter. Yue Ji slowly raised her head and looked at the bronze mirror on the table again. The mirror surface was calm and waveless, reflecting the moonlight outside the window, like a frozen lake.
She hesitated for a moment, then reached out to pick up the bronze mirror, and her fingertips brushed the runes on the edge. The cool metallic touch calmed her down a bit. She walked to the full-length mirror, held the bronze mirror in front of her, and made the two mirrors form a staggered angle. This was a little game that children in the Mirror Fantasy Kingdom knew. They could see countless versions of themselves in the staggered mirrors.
But this time, countless Tsukihime did not appear in the interlaced mirrors.
Deep in the angle between the two mirrors, where the light and shadow are distorted, there is a vague outline. He is taller than her and wearing a dark cloak. His face cannot be seen clearly. He can only see a hand holding something. The thing reflects fine light, like... the edge of a metal?
Yue Ji held her breath and wanted to see more clearly, but the outline suddenly disappeared, leaving only a chaotic light and shadow.
At this moment, there was a knock on the dormitory door.
"Classmate Yue Ji? Are you in there?" It was Lin Che's voice, with the clearness unique to young people, "The instructor asked us to go to the training ground, saying that there will be temporary training."
Yue Ji quickly put away the bronze mirror and stuffed it under the pillow. She calmed down before walking over and opening the door.
Lin Che, Su Li and Kai were standing outside the door. Lin Che was holding a magic theory book in her hand, Su Li was holding a small pot of green plants, and Kai was carrying his flame staff. All three of them had a little doubt on their faces.
"You don't look good," Su Li asked with concern, lightly touching her arm with her fingertips, "Are you feeling uncomfortable?"
Yue Ji shook her head and avoided Su Li's gaze: "It's okay, maybe a little tired. Let's go."
She followed the three of them to the training ground, and the lights in the corridor cast their intertwined shadows on the ground. Yue Ji couldn't help but look back at her dormitory door, her heart echoing over and over again with the mouth shape of the person in the mirror and the blurry outline.
Star map...silver seal...dark cloak...
These fragments were like scattered puzzle pieces. She didn't know yet what they could piece together, but a strong premonition arose in her heart - this exploration of the secret realm might have been intertwined with her destiny from a long time ago.
The wind from the training ground blew over with the smell of vegetation. Yue Ji gathered the broken hair in front of her forehead and suppressed her uneasiness. No matter what secrets were hidden in the mirror, she knew that she could no longer hide behind the mirror like before.
